import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from some_module import delete_symptom, login_to_virtual_clinic

class TestVirtualClinic(unittest.TestCase):

    @patch('some_module.check_symptom_usage')
    def test_delete_symptom_with_usage(self, mock_check_symptom_usage):
        # Arrange
        symptom_code = 'S123'
        mock_check_symptom_usage.return_value = True

        # Act & Assert
        with self.assertRaises(Exception) as context:
            delete_symptom(symptom_code)
        self.assertEqual(str(context.exception), "Symptom Code used, cannot be deleted")

    @patch('some_module.check_symptom_usage')
    def test_delete_symptom_without_usage(self, mock_check_symptom_usage):
        # Arrange
        symptom_code = 'S123'
        mock_check_symptom_usage.return_value = False

        # Act
        result = delete_symptom(symptom_code)

        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(result)  # Assuming delete_symptom returns True on successful deletion

    @patch('some_module.requests.get')
    def test_login_to_virtual_clinic_success(self, mock_get):
        # Arrange
        url = 'https://virtualclinic.com/login'
        mock_get.return_value.status_code = 200

        # Act
        result = login_to_virtual_clinic(url)

        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(result)  # Assuming login_to_virtual_clinic returns True on successful login

    @patch('some_module.requests.get')
    def test_login_to_virtual_clinic_failure(self, mock_get):
        # Arrange
        url = 'https://virtualclinic.com/login'
        mock_get.return_value.status_code = 404

        # Act
        result = login_to_virtual_clinic(url)

        # Assert
        self.assertFalse(result)  # Assuming login_to_virtual_clinic returns False on failed login

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
